2026-10-10: fixes for the fourth independent S7 review (docs/verification/phrf-cmp-s7-independent-review4-20261010.md), commit 21ecfb4a on work/phrf-s7-reconcile, not pushed.

H1: a fatal throwable now sets a sticky accountingUncertain flag before the exception is selected, and the marker stays whenever the flag is set. Test: review4 H1. The feed blocks, the caller is interrupted, then the feed throws OutOfMemoryError; the result is Interrupted, the marker stays and the resume refuses.
H2: a write-once random output-id is added; identity = SHA-256(stamp.json ++ output-id). Test: review4 H2, move and recreate at the same path; the old raise is refused and accepted again on the original.
M: all authorization records are re-sealed under their own run ids. Test: review4 M, meta/accounting-recovery/dead is now sealed.
L1: the verifier enforces the CostState.MaxInvocations bound. Test: review4 L1.
L2: plans allow at most 10000 datasets (SealedNames.MaxDatasets). Test: review4 L2.
Reverting all fixes together fails 5 of 6 review4 tests; the sixth (malformed output-id refusal) is a new feature. Files restored and verified by SHA-256.
Gates: JVM 520 total (510 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed); JS 246 passed; scalafimCompileAll exit 0 with 0 warnings.
Tooling note: the sbt-warm server for this worktree wedged; the client reported a false exit 0 on "disconnected". I killed only the worktree's own server (PID 88775) and reran the JS and compileAll gates.
Synthetic only; a fifth review is pending.
